captions_note: the glass word is the caption for that word: keep the reel's captions, and hide them just for that word (--hide-captions a-b)
steps: edit the CLIP block: TEXT always; the rest only if a printout says so
run glass.py measure      # 4. camera, zoom, plate, head, the word's box, level, light. LOOK at work/measure.jpg
run onsets.py      # optional: if the glass lands visibly early or late, give T_IN in seconds
run glass.py still SAFE=1      # 5. six key frames -> work/stills/sheet.jpg
run glass.py bake      # 6. assets/fx.mp4 (up to 4 workers; WORKERS=n)
run build.py      # 7. sounds + index.html (same switches you want in the render, e.g. SFX=0)
run post.py      # 8. frame count, phone copy, stills, work/qa/sheet_*.jpg from the final mp4
